\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 251-254 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R259-first-pass-words-from-chapters-251-254}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a mistake and history.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a father-in-law, a mother-in-law, a son-in-law, a daughter-in-law, a boyfriend
  \item a difference, an example, the truth, a lie, a secret
  \item a bank account, a loan, a debt, a tax, a form
  \item a vehicle seat, a steering wheel, a wheel, an engine, petrol
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A father-in-law? (\textbf{il suocero}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{la suocera}.) A son-in-law? (\textbf{il genero}.) A daughter-in-law? (\textbf{la nuora}.) A boyfriend? (\textbf{il fidanzato}.) A difference? (\textbf{la differenza}.) An example? (\textbf{l'esempio}.) The truth? (\textbf{la verità}.) A lie? (\textbf{la bugia}.) A secret? (\textbf{il segreto}.) A bank account? (\textbf{il conto corrente}.) A loan? (\textbf{il prestito}.) A debt? (\textbf{il debito}.) A tax? (\textbf{la tassa}.) A form? (\textbf{il modulo}.) A vehicle seat? (\textbf{il sedile}.) A steering wheel? (\textbf{il volante}.) A wheel? (\textbf{la ruota}.) An engine? (\textbf{il motore}.) Petrol? (\textbf{la benzina}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

A fountain? (\textbf{la fontana}.) A gate? (\textbf{il cancello}.) A fence? (\textbf{la recinzione}.) A courtyard? (\textbf{il cortile}.) A cellar? (\textbf{la cantina}.) A flame? (\textbf{la fiamma}.) Lightning? (\textbf{il fulmine}.) Thunder? (\textbf{il tuono}.) A rainbow? (\textbf{l'arcobaleno}.) The climate? (\textbf{il clima}.) Metal? (\textbf{il metallo}.) A brick? (\textbf{il mattone}.) A small bag? (\textbf{il sacchetto}.) A thread? (\textbf{il filo}.) A tool? (\textbf{lo strumento}.) A fan? (\textbf{il tifoso}.) A prize? (\textbf{il premio}.) A delay? (\textbf{il ritardo}.) A connection? (\textbf{la coincidenza}.) The return? (\textbf{il ritorno}.) A university? (\textbf{l'università}.) A mark? (\textbf{il voto}.) A teacher?
